title: ArcCivs173: preserve compatible full unpaid plan during one-plot recovery
owner_requirement: Remove arbitrary construction prohibitions and fix all stalled villages; retain the complete34building profile and real native constraints.

ore_policy.before: Input terrain uses a curated whitelist of soils/rocks/plants and refuses other materials, including ordinary ores.
ore_policy.after: Global material eligibility remains the active172blacklist;173 aligns initial-floor and road-maintenance consumers with that policy and actual physical support.
ore_policy.unchanged: Existing ownership, native before-images, physical support/headroom, liquids, bedrock no-mutation, admitted buildings and roads, stored objects, paid batches and complete34profile checks.
ore_policy.ore_mining_rewards: unchanged; terrain preparation does not become a mining reward
ore_policy.native_support_only: Reading or retaining a support cell destroys no material. Only actually replaced cells count as world-cell removal.
ore_policy.output_contract: Construction still emits its existing concrete DIRT/STONE/AIR recipe. Its output palette does not restrict input terrain and does not mint ore or valuables.

progression_scope: No world writes, currency, item reward, mining chance, supplies target or construction work rate changes during plan calculation/adoption. Recovered ordinary construction remains paid through unchanged native journals. Full34profile, geometry non-overlap, actual building and paid route protection, native volume/cell authority and physical support remain. Any throughput change is restoration of ordinary construction and production, not a new reward.
assumptions: Assessment recorded before173implementation; accepted-plan geometry alone creates no items, workers or world blocks.
Participants1/4/5settlements and0/1/2new sites per settlement-day are planning sensitivity, not measured activity or new caps.
Existing ordinary paid construction and Auto deficit restock may resume after recovery. Actual item throughput is unknown; no zero indirect effect or self-sufficiency claim.
Founding reserve remains96OAK_LOG/96COBBLESTONE/24BREAD once per newID; existingID repeats0.
No direct Vault, premium tokens or playerXP mint/burn; no conversion of terrain, construction or producer items to invented money values.
Active SELL and future SHADOW contracts remain distinct and unchanged.

live_verification: After activation verify at least one new ordinary native paid construction in Village1 and2, preserving actual buildings and ordinary inventory. Source/test proof, disk delivery, loaded version and live behavior are separate.
scope: Input policy applies to unprotected ordinary block materials, not only ores. Valuable block material alone is not an authority rule. Existing cut/fill no-drop accounting and physical budgets remain; actual modified-cell and later production throughput are not yet measured.
proposed_change: A compatible replacement of one unpaid plot may retain all other accepted unpaid plots, their routes and the accepted perimeter. The complete existing layout validation and infrastructure forecast still run; actual buildings and paid routes cannot move. Incompatible replacements use the existing complete replan or refusal. Avoid recomputing a new separator solely because the one replacement changed horizontal position.

additional_input_policy_fixes.before: A native full timber floor at the initial hall approach is rejected by a separate logs check; road upkeep rejects ordinary solid support such as OBSIDIAN/STONE_BRICKS through a separate soil whitelist.
additional_input_policy_fixes.after: Initial approach accepts ordinary physically stable full timber support through the shared terrain/physics predicate. Road maintenance uses shared blacklist eligibility plus actual stable full support, preserving explicit existing route-step/dirt-path and side-attachment safety.
additional_input_policy_fixes.economic_effect: Restores ordinary founding/maintenance access. No new reward, material refund, free native mutation, shop change or supply target. Existing journal payments/authority/foreign buildings/data/liquid guards remain. Actual downstream items and replaced world cells are unmeasured.

bounded_retry_fix.before: A native-proven recovery candidate whose complete forecast exhausts the deterministic dry-perimeter solver budget is retried forever; skipPrepared advances only for geometric/no-site refusal.
bounded_retry_fix.after: Only a complete recovery forecast rejected with autonomy-search-budget and stage=dry-perimeter advances to the next native-proven candidate after the existing fresh-context fence. Transient world-busy/stale/save/native-search outcomes remain unchanged.
bounded_retry_fix.unchanged: One complete forecast per existing five-minute retry,64native-attempt bound, full34profile, actual structures/paid routes, native proof and ordinary payment. No higher resource quotas, new reward or supply target.
